cross the die boundary and four 12-bit converters digitise them for the range FFT. ⑤ The range-Doppler map feeds CFAR detection and angle estimation. ⑥ The target list goes to the ECU over CAN-FD, div.div: Reading path ① The crystal, ramp generator, PLL and VCO synthesise the chirp. ② The doubler reaches 77 GHz and the two PAs transmit. ③ Each of four echoes is amplified, mixed with the LO, filtered. ④ The IF signals cross the die boundary and four 12-bit converters digitise them for the range FFT. ⑤ The range-Doppler map feeds CFAR detection and angle estimation. ⑥ The target list goes to the ECU over CAN-FD, 100BASE-T1 or MIPI CSI-2. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
